title: Discrete BJT OVP-to-BREAK_N path: 4.7k current-limited topology check

pre_fix_direct_collector_op.topology: pre-fix: PNP collector directly tied to NPN base; no R_BOV_DRIVE
pre_fix_direct_collector_op.model_limit: one .op with generic BF=420 Gummel-Poon devices; diagnostic only, not all-corner device evidence

parameters.name: normal_32p4V_SAFEon
parameters.candidate_topology: BC857C PNP E=SAFE_5V, B through 10k from BUSOV_N, C drives BC847C base through R_BOV_DRIVE=4.7k; BC847C NPN E=GND, C=BREAK_N; 10k base pulldown; 2.2k BREAK_N pullup to MCU_3V3
parameters.bjt_model: standard Gummel-Poon models with BF=420 (datasheet BC847C/BC857C C-group minimum hFE at the specified 2mA test point); not manufacturer device-specific SPICE files, and low-current/temperature behavior is not guaranteed
parameters.comparator_model: actual resistor ratios/hysteresis and C_OV_SENSE, behavioral open-collector comparator with VOL corner; no TLV1704 macromodel, propagation delay/noise/overdrive omitted
parameters.chopper_gate_logic: BUSOV_N < 1.0V and SAFE_5V present; BREAK_N is separately logged and does not enable Q7
parameters.q7: SW Ron=11.25mOhm behavior model from 4.5mOhm max at VGS=4.5V times 2.5 hot factor; no IRLB manufacturer macro
parameters.supply_measurement_scope: SAFE rail current includes modeled OVP reference/comparator and BJT path; Bdrv is an ideal behavioral voltage source, so UCC27511 gate-charge/quiescent current and its 10k gate pulldown are not included
parameters.scope: topology/polarity and BJT current-limiting check only; 4ms short transient; not 1s thermal or board validation
